title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Confirms First Story Synopsis & Teases Big Fights
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work on making its comeback for Season 4 , and it’s teasing some big fights coming in the new episodes with the first story synopsis for the next half of the Culling Game. Jujutsu Kaisen made its highly anticipated return for Season 3 of the anime earlier this year, and with it took on one of the most chaotic arcs of Gege Akutami’s original manga with a deadly new tournament introducing a ton of new fighters and their respective abilities. But it unfortunately left things off on a huge cliffhanger.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 is, like the title suggests, going to pick up right after that cliffhanger finale from the third season , and with it adapts the next major phase of the deadly tournament. The first story synopsis for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 has now been revealed on the anime’s official website , and with it gives fans a much clearer look on what kind of fights are coming in the new season and who specifically is going to be thrown into the action with teases for Hakari, Panda, Maki and more.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Teases the Culling Game’s Next Big Fights

“As their respective stories intersect, the Culling Phase enters a new phase,” the synopsis for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 teases. “At the same time, Hakari and Panda head to Tokyo 2 in search of Kashimo, who possesses 100 points.” That’s not only teeing up their fight, but also makes sure to include a reference to Maki as she, “destroys the Zenin family and heads off somewhere.” It’s also sure to include Choso and Yuki Tsukumo , as they are currently guarding Tengen. While the final tease showcases that “Sukina is plotting something…in the Culling Game, the chaos of curses continues to evolve.”

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 has been dropping some big hits about Sukuna and whatever grand plan that he has in the works. From the release of the very first teaser to the launch of the newest key visual , the anime has been making sure that despite all of the chaos of the Culling Game, fans remember that Sukuna is lying in wait to enact whatever plan he has in the works. And there’s already tons for Yuji and the others to juggle heading into what’s next.

When Does Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Come Out?

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 has unfortunately yet to confirm a release window or date as of the time of this writing, but it seems to be making steady progress towards its debut. The voice cast is set to return to reprise their respective characters, but any new voice cast additions have yet to be revealed as of this time. Much of the production staff behind it has yet to be confirmed either as it’s only been revealed that Takeru Sato will be directing the new episodes for studio MAPPA .

The biggest tease of all of this has been Sukuna’s role in it all. While it’s yet to be revealed what kind of plan he has for Yuji ( and potentially Megumi Fushiguro as he’s been alluding to all along ), it’s clear that it’s not even a part of whatever Kenjaku has planned for the Culling Game. It’s going to be a lot of chaos unfolding at once, so make sure you catch up with Jujutsu Kaisen now streaming with platforms like Crunchyroll and Netflix in the meantime.

title: Hunter x Hunter Fans Once Again Celebrate a Major Anniversary
content:
Hunter x Hunter’s creator, Yoshihiro Togashi, has long been anime royalty, evne before he introduced the world to the likes of Gon, Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio. Prior to entering this world of hunters, the manga artist brought the story of Yusuke Urameshi to life in Yu Yu Hakusho . While this shonen series ended decades ago, the hunters’ tale continues tot his day. With Hunter x Hunter continuing to release new chapters to further flesh out the Succession Contest Arc, shonen enthusiasts are once again celebrating a major story event that only happens on September 1st.

Following the quartet achieving their initial goals of achieving hunter status via the gruelish exams, Kurapika, Leorio, Killua, and Gon have some individual tasks to complete. Thanks to this fact, they need to seperate from one another, but make a promise to reunite in York New City on September 1st, which has become a major date for Hunter x Hunter fans. Fans of the series each year will celebrate this milestone by celebrating Gon’s story, via fan art, discussions, and everything else you can think of. One fan has even traveled to New York City’s Times Square to truly hammer home the arc that had major implictions on the shonen franchise, as you can see by clicking here .

Hunter x Hunter’s Succession Contest Continues

It can sometimes be tough being a fan of Hunter x Hunter , especially when you consider the long delays that the manga has suffered in recent years. Yoshihiro has made it no secret that his health issues have caused him to often delay the release of new chapters, with a previous hiatus taking years to see the world of hunters make a comeback. Luckily, the manga artist has been hard at work to make sure that the story continues in the pages of Weekly Shonen Jump, frequently sharing big updates on his upcoming chapters’ progression.

Shockingly enough, while this reunion is one that fans will celebrate , it’s been an almost unbelievable amount of time since the manga’s “fantastic four” have been in the same room. In fact, the last instance that saw Gon, Killua, Leorio, and Kurapika all in the same room was in the 119th chapter, which was released over twenty-five years ago. Ever since, the quartet have been working on their own individual issues and there has been no hints that they’ll reunite anytime soon. In major arcs such as Greed Island Arc, The Chimera Ant Arc, and the Succession Contest Arc, varying protagonists have taken the lead. With Togashi working on quite a few chapters as we speak, Hunter x Hunter fans have been crossing their fingers that we’ll one day see the heroes all reunite to once again explore their world.

title: Red River Anime Reveals New Cast Member, Theme Song Artists
content:
The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga revealed the new theme song artists and new cast member for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday. Nana Mizuki will perform the new opening theme song "Akatsuki no Hoshi" (Morning Star), and Ryu Matsuyama will perform the new ending theme song "flow feat. Yūko Andō ." Mizuki will also voice the character Ursula, a false goddess impersonating Ishtar, in the series.

Nana Mizuki as Ursula

The anime premiered in NTV 's "AnichU" programming block on July 7 at 25:35 (effectively, July 8 at 1:35 a.m.), and on BS NTV on July 8. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

The cast includes:

• Mirai Tachibana as Yuri

• Wataru Katō as Kail Muršili (later King Muršili II)

• Aya Uchida as Queen Nakia, the queen of the Hittite Empire

• Shōya Chiba as Zannanza Hattušili, the fourth-born prince of the Hittite Empire

• Tomoaki Maeno as Ilbani, Prince Kail's aide and advisor

• Kōji Yusa as Urhi, Nakia's servant

• Kōsuke Toriumi as Prince Mattiwaza, the Prince of Darkness of the chariot-riding Mitanni kingdom

• Tomohiro Ōno as Kikkuri, Prince Kail's servant

• Shiki Aoki as Hadi, a daughter of the Hatti clan, servant of Kail, and elder sister to Ryui and Shala

• Natsumi Kawaida as Ryui and Misato Matsuoka as Shala, Hadi's younger twin sisters

• Haruki Ishiya as Kash, the leader of the Hittite chariot corps

• Junya Enoki as Rusafa, the leader of the Hittite archer corps

• Shinichirō Kamio as Mittannamuwa, the leader of the Hittite infantry corps

• Sōma Saitō as User Ramses, Kail's greatest rival

• Shun Horie as Juda Haspasrupi, the sixth prince in line for the Hittite throne

Kōsuke Kobayashi ( Waccha PriMagi! , Alice or Alice ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Yoriko Tomita ( The Elusive Samurai , My Dress-Up Darling ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Kenji Fujisaki ( YU-NO: A girl who chants love at the bound of this world. , Blood Lad ) is designing the characters. Yoshihisa Hirano is composing the music, while Hiroto Morishita is the sound director. Team Kawadon is credited for sound production.

Historical researchers include Kimiyoshi Matsumura and Daisuke Yoshida , who are members of the Japanese Institute of Anatolian Archaeology as part of the Middle Eastern Culture Center in Japan.

Viz Media describes the manga's first volume:

Yuri, a pretty Japanese girl, is ecstatic after passing her college entrance exam and having her first kiss with her childhood friend-turned boyfriend. However, her luck soon changes. She starts to notice that water becomes agitated whenever she goes near it. One night, hands appear out of a puddle on the street and drag her into the water! Transported to an ancient village in the Middle East, she is then captured by armed troops and taken to the Queen's palace for a human sacrifice.

Viz Media started releasing the manga in English in 2004, and released all 28 volumes between 2004 to 2010. The company then started re-releasing the manga in 3-in-1 omnibus editions in October 2024, and released the eighth omnibus volume on July 21.

Shinohara originally serialized the manga from 1995 to 2002 in Shogakukan 's Shōjo Comic ( Sho-Comi ) magazine.

The manga inspired a stage play by the famed all-female Takarazuka Revue troupe in 2018.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Announces 3rd Anniversary Season 2 Screening Event
content:
Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End will celebrate the third anniversary of its TV anime with a special Season 2 screening event on September 26, 2026. Select episodes from the anime’s 10-episode second season will be shown at nine theaters in Japan. The event will mark three years since the first season premiered on September 29, 2023.

A stage greeting will follow the screening at TOHO Cinemas Hibiya in Tokyo, with Atsumi Tanezaki (Frieren), Kana Ichinose (Fern), Chiaki Kobayashi (Stark), Tarusuke Shingaki (Genau) and Reina Ueda (Methode) all making apperances. The cast will look back on Season 2 and celebrate the anime’s third anniversary. Similar activities were done in previous years , and you can also see our top 20 characters feature for the anime’s second anniversary.

ALSO READ: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Film Concert Announces First International Performance at Carnegie Hall in New York Frieren Real Escape Game Sequel Reveals New Visual, Expands to More Locations in Japan

Attendees at all nine theaters will receive a set of two commemorative postcards. One features an illustration of Macht of the Golden Land drawn by character designer Maru Takase, which was previously distributed during the Frieren special event at Anime Expo 2026 in Los Angeles.

The second will feature a new visual commemorating the anime’s third anniversary, which will be unveiled on the day of the screening.

Kanehito Yamada writes the Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End manga, with illustrations from Tsukasa Abe. It has been serialized in Shogakukan’s Weekly Shonen Sunday manga magazine since April 2020. The manga is available to read via Sunday Webry, Viz Media, and the Shogakukan Comic website, while Crunchyroll streams the anime.

Studio MADHOUSE is in charge of the anime adaptation. The first season was directed by Keiichiro Saito, while Tomoya Kitagawa directed the second. The series composition was handled by Tomohiro Suzuki. Reiko Nagasawa was the character designer, with the chief animation direction led by Yuri Fujinaka, Reiko Nagasawa, and Maru Takase. Evan Call composed the music. Season 3 is set to release in October 2027.

title: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! Celebrates 20th Anniversary With "REBORN! MUSIC MONTH"
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! TV anime is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a month-long series of music-related projects in September 2026. The campaign, titled “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” is the seventh project announced as part of the anime’s anniversary celebration .

An official playlist featuring 25 songs from the anime was released across music subscription services on September 1. The collection includes opening and ending theme songs from throughout the TV series.

Beginning from September 2, the official YouTube channel will also release creditless versions of the anime’s past theme song sequences, with one video scheduled to be uploaded each day. According to the announcement, these versions were previously available only through physical home video releases and had not been officially released online.

The anniversary music campaign will continue on September 27 with a character song listening party. Music from Discs 1-6 of the Katekyo Hitman REBORN! Official Character Song Complete Collection Ultimate CD Box will be featured together at a YouTube Premiere.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Passes 1 Billion Yen in 4 Days, New CM Released
content:
Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Walpurgisnacht Rising has surpassed 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office within its first four days. A new CM trailer featuring previously unseen footage from the film was also released.

The movie opened in Japan on August 28 and passed the 1 billion yen mark by August 31. It also ranked first for both admissions and box office revenue during its opening weekend. The four-day result puts Walpurgisnacht Rising ahead of the initial pace of the franchise’s previous movie, Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Rebellion . Released in 2013, Rebellion ultimately earned more than 2 billion yen at the Japanese box office.

Walpurgisnacht Rising is the first new movie in the main Madoka Magica series in 13 years and serves as a continuation of Rebellion . Studio SHAFT animated the movie, with Akiyuki Shinbo as chief director and Yukihiro Miyamato as the director.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica , created by the Magica Quartet (Akiyuki Shinbo, Ume Aoki, Gen Urobuchi, and producer Atsuhiro Iwakami) first premiered in January 2011. The series ran for 12 episodes, concluding in April of the same year, although the final two episodes were delayed due to the Great East Japan Earthquake. While the TV anime wrapped up the main story, the Puella Magi Madoka Magica franchise has since expanded into various media, including several manga adaptations, a novel by Nitroplus, a dedicated magazine, and video games. In October 2012, two recap films, Beginnings and Eternal , were released, which condensed the anime’s events with some new material. A third film, Rebellion , was released in October 2013, continuing the story with a fresh story that served as a prequel to Walpurgisnacht . These movies got an Ultra HD Blu-ray release on January 29, 2025.

In addition to the main series, the Magia Record spin-off story has its own anime adaptation, produced by Studio SHAFT, along with a mobile game. The new mobile game, Magia Exedra , launched on March 27, 2025 on multiple platforms (iOS, Android, and Windows).

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 15 Preview
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 15 (Episode 81 overall) preview ahead of its September 2, 2026 premiere. This will be the fourth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc . The first part of the anime dominated our Spring 2026 awards , winning a total of 19 awards, while the anime ranked third in the latest weekly ranking after Episode 14. Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

You can watch the preview trailer for the fifteenth episode below.

title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie Reveals New 25th Anniversary Visual, 4K Remaster Screening
content:
Cowboy Bebop: The Movie ( Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door ) has revealed a new visual commemorating the 25th anniversary of its theatrical release. A 4K remastered version of the film will also return to theaters in Japan on October 30, 2026.

The new anniversary visual was drawn by Toshihiro Kawamoto, who served as character designer and animation director on the film. Art director Atsushi Morikawa handled the background, while the main title was designed by Toshiaki Uesugi of Mach 55. Merchandise featuring the new artwork is also being planned.

ALSO READ: Interview: Shinichiro Watanabe on Creation Process, Flamenco Idea, Lazarus & More ’It’s Like a Heartless Monster’: Cowboy Bebop Creator Comes Down Hard on Generative AI in Anime

The upcoming 4K remaster was created under the full supervision of director Shinichiro Watanabe. The nationwide theatrical run will include screenings at cinemas across Japan, including locations in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka, Aichi, Hiroshima and other prefectures. Attendee bonuses are also planned, with further details to be announced.

Watanabe commented on the film’s return to theaters:

“I hope you will experience the crystallization of the passion and soul we poured into this work, in the darkness of a movie theater.”

Originally released in Japan on September 1, 2001, Cowboy Bebop: The Movie is a feature-length continuation of the Cowboy Bebop anime, following Spike Spiegel and the Bebop crew as they chase a bounty connected to a deadly incident on Mars.

title: Baki Isekai Spinoff Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
TMS Anime announced on Monday that Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh wa Isekai Tensei Shitemo Ikkō ni Kamawan ( Baki Side Story - Kaioh Retsu Doesn't Mind At All If He Gets Reincarnated in Another World), a spinoff manga of Keisuke Itagaki 's Baki manga, is receiving a TV anime.adaptation.

The Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh wa Isekai Tensei Shitemo Ikkō ni Kamawan manga launched in Akita Shoten 's Monthly Shōnen Champion magazine in 2020. Eiji Mutsui is drawing the manga, and Keisuke Itagaki and Sai Ihara ( Daisuke Ihara ) are credited for the original concept and story, respectively. Aktia Shoten published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2021, and the 16th volume on March 6. The 17th volume will ship on September 8, and the series has over 2 million copies in circulation (print and digital combined).

The staff for Baki The Grappler STAGE had announced in July a stage play adaptation titled Baki The Grappler STAGE Gaiden -Retsu Kaioh wa Isekai Tensei Shitemo Ikkō ni Kamawan. The stage play will run from March 19-22, 2027 at Owl Spot (Toshima Ward Performing Arts Exchange Center) in Tokyo.

Itagaki's original Baki The Grappler martial arts manga ran for 42 volumes in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine from 1991 to 1999. Kodama Tales began publishing the manga worldwide in English in October 2025.

The Baki sequel manga ran for 31 volumes from 1999 to 2005. Media Do releases the manga in English. After Baki , Itagaki published the 37-volume Hanma Baki manga in Weekly Shōnen Champion from 2005 to 2012. The first Baki-Dou manga, the overall fourth manga in the franchise, launched in Weekly Shōnen Champion in March 2014 and ended in April 2018 with 22 volumes.

A new Baki-Dou manga launched in Weekly Shōnen Champion in October 2018, and it ended in June 2023. (The new Baki-Dou manga uses different characters for "Baki" in the title from the previous Baki-Dou manga, although it retains the name " Baki-Dou .") The latest manga in the franchise, Baki Rahen , launched in Weekly Shōnen Champion in August 2023.

The new anime of Itagaki's Baki ( New Grappler Baki : In Search of Our Strongest Hero ) manga debuted its first season on Netflix in June 2018 inside Japan, and it ran for 26 episodes ending in December 2018. Netflix posted the first 13 episodes outside of Japan in December 2018, followed by the second half of the first season in March 2019.

The Baki: Dai Raitaisai-hen anime then debuted worldwide on Netflix with all episodes at once in June 2020.

Baki Hanma is the third Baki series on Netflix , and a sequel to the Baki: Dai Raitaisai-hen series. The anime debuted worldwide on Netflix in September 2021 with all 12 episodes.

The second season of Baki Hanma debuted worldwide on Netflix in July 2023, with the "Tale of Pickle & The Pickle War Saga" story. The anime's "The Father VS Son Saga" story debuted in August 2023.

BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai , the anime of Keisuke Itagaki 's first Baki-Dou manga, premiered worldwide on Netflix on February 26. The anime's first 13 episodes were made available all at once. The second part or cours (quarter of a year) premiered exclusively worldwide on Netflix on June 18. All 12 episodes were made available at once.

title: Live-Action It's Strictly Business Series Announces Cast. Staff, November 5 Debut
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Mitsubachi Miyuki 's It’s Strictly Business (Eigyо̄ Desu kara) boys-love manga revealed on Tuesday the series' teaser visual, main cast and staff, and November 5 premiere.

The series will star:

Sōta Uemura as Ren Ashihara

Rio Takahashi as Issei Kuji

The series will premiere on November 5 on the BS Fuji channel at 24:30 JST (effectively November 6 at 12:30 a.m.).

Kozue Sasaki and Kana Urara are directing the series, and Uiko Miura is writing the script.

Yen Press publishes the series in English under the name It’s Strictly Business , but had initially announced it with the title I’m Just in a Faux BL . The company describes the story:

College boy Kiyo (Ren) has one thing on his mind—girls, girls, girls! But after struggling for-EVER to get the ladies swooning over his every move, he figures he's gotta try a new trick. Enter his smolderingly sexy clubmate Issei…a stud muffin who'll act as the perfect foil for his Mr. Refreshing vibe. However, after being tragically friend-zoned by all the gals as their best gay buddy, he soon realizes he may be in over his head when it looks like Issei intends to turn faux into beau…

Miyuki launched the series in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine in April 2021. Hakusensha shipped the first compiled book volume in October 2024. Yen Press will ship the first volume on September 22.

Miyuki launched the Cheeky Brat ( Namaiki Zakari. ) manga in Hana to Yume in January 2014, and ended the series in December 2021. The manga's 23rd and final compiled book volume shipped in March 2022 with a six-page epilogue chapter. Miyuki has also published other short chapters since the manga ended. Yen Press published the 12th volume in November 2024.

Yen Press is also releasing Miyuki's Stray Cat & Wolf and Spring Storm and Monster manga in English. Yen Press shipped the fifth volume of Stray Cat & Wolf on August 25, and the sixth volume of Spring Storm and Monster will ship on October 27.
